Uddhav Thackeray criticizes BJP over Ram temple donations and party defections

Uddhav Thackeray, chief of Shiv Sena (UBT), has launched a strong attack against the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). He criticized the BJP's handling of Ram temple donations, calling it a 'shop', and accused them of betraying Hindutva principles. Thackeray also alleged that the BJP was involved in orchestrating defections from his party to weaken the opposition and questioned the citizenship proof stance of the BJP. Meanwhile, a separate report from The Commune highlights allegations against the Tamil Nadu government regarding pre-existing investments and bribe demands.
